description: Use this when the user wants a ranked list of US stocks or ETFs by a performance or risk metric, optionally within a sector or ETF category (e.g. "lowest volatility dividend ETFs", "highest Sharpe tech stocks this year", "energy stocks with the smallest drawdown"). Covers about 2,500 US-listed stocks and about 940 US ETFs, end-of-day. Not for fundamentals (P/E, revenue), news or buy recommendations.

filters.description: Optional bounds in each metric's own units, e.g. {metric: 'beta1y', max: 1}. maxDrawdown1yPct is negative, so a drawdown smaller than 20% is {metric: 'maxDrawdown1yPct', min: -20}

sector.description: Case-insensitive match on a stock's GICS sector (e.g. Information Technology, Health Care, Energy, Financials) or an ETF's category (e.g. Dividend, Bonds, Treasury, Large Cap Growth, Emerging Markets, Gold)

sortBy.description: Metric to rank by. For lowest risk, sort maxDrawdown1yPct descending (closest to 0) or beta1y ascending

type.description: Limit to stocks, ETFs, or both

name: screen_securities

asOf.description: Market date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the latest close behind every number

beta1y.description: Versus SPY, from daily returns over the past year

maxDrawdown1yPct.description: Worst peak-to-trough fall over the past year (negative)

sector.description: GICS sector for stocks, category for ETFs

statsSince.description: YYYY-MM-DD, set only when there is less than a year of history: the 1Y figures (return, drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, beta, alpha) then run from this first close, and so does the YTD return if it falls this year. Screens on those metrics leave such securities out

url.description: Redstone screener with every column and filter

title: Screen stocks and ETFs by performance and risk
